intro.title: Welcome to CineGen!
intro.description: CineGen is an AI-powered platform that helps you create cinematic content. Follow these steps to create your first short movie from idea to final video.

createProject.title: Create a New Project
createProject.summary: Start by setting up your movie project with basic information
createProject.description: Every movie starts with a project. Here you define the genre, setting, plot, and duration of your short film. This information helps the AI understand what kind of content to generate.

instructions.1: Click 'Projects' in the left menu and then 'New Project'
instructions.2: Choose a genre (drama, comedy, action, horror, etc.)
instructions.3: Write a short plot description - what happens in your story
instructions.4: Select the desired duration (1-5 minutes recommended for beginners)

createProject.tip: Start with a simple story with 1-2 characters. Complex plots work better once you understand the workflow.

addCharacters.title: Add Characters
addCharacters.summary: Create the characters that will appear in your movie
addCharacters.description: Characters are the actors in your movie. Upload reference images to help the AI maintain visual consistency throughout all generated images and videos.

instructions.1: Go to 'Characters' in the left menu
instructions.2: Click 'New Character' and give them a name
instructions.3: Upload 1-5 reference images showing the character from different angles
instructions.4: Write a brief description of their personality and appearance

addCharacters.tip: Use consistent images - same person, similar lighting. This helps AI generate consistent-looking characters across scenes.

generateContent.title: Generate Scene Content
generateContent.summary: Let AI write dialogue and create image descriptions for each scene
generateContent.description: For each scene, the AI will generate dialogue, emotions, actions, and detailed prompts for the start and end images. This creates the story backbone.

instructions.1: Open your project and go to the Scenes tab
instructions.3: Review the generated dialogue and image prompts
instructions.4: Edit any text if needed - you have full control

generateContent.tip: Generate all scene content first before moving to images. This ensures story coherence.

generateImages.title: Generate Scene Images
generateImages.summary: Create start and end frame images for each scene
generateImages.description: Each scene needs a start image (how it begins) and end image (how it ends). These images will be used to generate the video with smooth transitions.

instructions.1: Make sure scene content (prompts) is generated first
instructions.3: Wait for both start and end images to be created
instructions.4: If you don't like an image, you can regenerate it

generateImages.tip: Check that characters look consistent between scenes. Regenerate any images that don't match.

generateVideos.title: Generate Scene Videos
generateVideos.summary: Transform your images into animated video clips
generateVideos.description: Using AI video generation, the start and end images are transformed into smooth 5-second video clips. The AI adds motion, expressions, and camera movement.

instructions.1: Ensure both start and end images exist for the scene
instructions.3: Wait for video generation (this may take 2-5 minutes)
instructions.4: Preview the video and regenerate if needed

generateVideos.tip: Professional mode produces better quality but costs more. Use Standard mode for drafts.

generateAudio.title: Generate Audio/Voiceover
generateAudio.summary: Add voice narration and dialogue to your scenes
generateAudio.description: Transform your written dialogue into spoken audio using AI text-to-speech. Choose different voices for different characters to bring your story to life.

instructions.1: Assign voices to characters in project settings
instructions.2: Click 'Generate Audio' for scenes with dialogue

generateAudio.tip: Match voice tone to character personality. An older character should have a mature voice.

combineInEditor.title: Combine in Video Editor
combineInEditor.summary: Download all assets and assemble your final movie
combineInEditor.description: CineGen generates individual scene videos and audio. To create your final movie, you'll need to combine them in a video editing software. This gives you full creative control.

instructions.1: Download all scene videos from your project
instructions.3: Import everything into your video editor
instructions.4: Arrange scenes, add transitions, music, and export

combineInEditor.tip: CapCut is free and beginner-friendly. DaVinci Resolve is free and more powerful.

tips.title: Pro Tips for Beginners
tips.1: Start small - create a 30-60 second movie first to learn the workflow.
tips.2: Use high-quality character reference images for best consistency.
tips.3: Review and edit AI-generated content before generating images.
tips.4: Generate images in batches - all scenes at once for consistent style.
tips.5: Save your project frequently and download generated assets as backups.
